exception: ValueError: Invalid format specifier ' true' for object of type 'str'
cause: A literal JSON example uses single braces inside an f-string.
effect: The confirmation path fails before its model request. product_info._confirm_before_denying catches the exception and returns an unknown-name fallback, so scenario error fields remain null while customers can be asked repeatedly to retype names.
coverage_gap: The offline suite applies a default mock to products.services.product_info.confirm_unplaced; its passing result does not verify this prompt is constructible.
